ctx.x: William Benbow's show. I joined him one of the... The third time I left Birmingham, I joined him, William Benbow, I think in (?) or Detroit, to South Carolina, North Carolina...
We went down to Havana, Cuba. I played this big theatre there. I think it was named Tropical Theatre. The theatre held round about five thousand people.
